title: Conditional scalar-to-operator tail transfer under an explicit per-edge majorant
question: Given a finite edge family and the explicit per-edge Banach-norm majorant ||K_e|| <= C*w(e), does the finite tail norm inherit the R-444 scalar shell bound C*T(R) without silently identifying K_e with an actual Q3LOCK term?
method: Freeze the R-444 positive-coordinate nearest-neighbour edge family, l1 lower-endpoint weight, finite box range [2,8]^3, radii 1..12 and constants 1, 3/2 and 7/3.
Run the primary Fraction lane, checking every finite scalar tail, termwise declared norm, saturated sum, signed triangle bound and ambient C*T(R) transfer.
Run a non-importing independent mixed-radix reconstruction over the same finite contract and compare all derived fields.
Run an eight-mutation hostile scope firewall covering claim, Q3LOCK, continuum, physical-empty, assumption, transfer-chain, status and PDF-policy overclaims.
Run the integrated verifier and compile Lean R445 for the abstract seminormed-additive-group triangle transfer and scaled R-444 arithmetic fixture.
finding: The primary lane passes its complete finite audit over 343 boxes, 102900 edges and 4116 tail rows. The independent reconstruction agrees on all derived fields, the hostile lane rejects 8/8 mutations, and the integrated verifier passes 29/29 with Lean R445 PASS. The finite implication ||sum_tail K_e|| <= C*T(R) is therefore audited only under the declared per-edge majorant.
decision_reason: R-445 records the next reusable finite implication after R-444 while preserving the existing T-054 forward method. It advances the conditional algebraic contract but does not derive the per-edge majorant for actual Q3LOCK commutator/history terms and therefore cannot close an operator, common-core, exhaustion, physical or QFT gate.
decision_scope: Finite Banach/seminorm transfer on the declared three-dimensional rectangular edge families and scalar R-444 majorant, with no Q3LOCK operator identification and no thermodynamic or continuum quantifier.
assumptions: The edge set, lower-endpoint l1 radius, nonnegative weight and finite contract are exactly those audited by R-444.
A common nonnegative constant C satisfies ||K_e|| <= C*w(e) for every retained edge.
The scalar finite-box dominance and ambient formula T(R) supplied by R-444 are reused without modification.
The additive seminorm obeys the triangle inequality formalized by Lean R445.
missing_assumptions: A Q3LOCK-specific derivation of the per-edge commutator/history-tail majorant.
A representation-independent weighted operator domain and common core.
Source-, cutoff-, volume-, shape-, phase- and history-uniform constants, exhaustion Cauchy and common alpha.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, sector coercivity, Reading-H physical-empty selection, continuum passage and any Yang--Mills or mass-gap theorem.

adversarial_review.check: The manifest and integrated firewall retain per_edge_majorant_assumed=true but operator_norm_of_actual_q3_terms=false and q3lock_commutator_identification=false.
All exhaustion, common-core, common-alpha, history, continuum, Pre-A and Sector-A flags remain false; the hostile lane rejects a continuum mutation.
The finite signed fixture is bounded by the saturated nonnegative sum and then by C*T(R); no cancellation is used to strengthen the result.
The non-claims and scope firewall exclude physical-empty, Yang--Mills, mass-gap and QFT conclusions.

boundary: R-445 is a T0 claim-nonbearing finite conditional norm-transfer lemma. It does not prove that actual Q3LOCK commutator or history terms satisfy the assumed majorant, and it does not close a weighted operator, common core, exhaustion, OS/KMS/GNS, physical-empty, continuum, C6, Pre-A, Sector-A, Yang--Mills or mass-gap result.
next_action: Keep R-445 as a reusable conditional input and derive, on the owner-declared common weighted domain, the actual Q3LOCK per-edge commutator/history-tail majorant. If that owner-level bound is unavailable, park this route without generating equivalent finite tables and record the precise missing interface.
no_overclaim: A finite triangle-inequality transfer under an assumed per-edge norm bound is not an actual Q3LOCK estimate, an exhaustion theorem, a physical-sector result or a Yang--Mills mass-gap proof.
